item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: The text of SCP-518-B really needs to be better. It's too self-consciously mysterious. It feels like you were going for something along the lines of the texts people unearth in M. R. James stories, but it lacks the sense of gravity, of foreboding. I think you were trying too hard to make it sound old-fashioned. That's a very hard thing to pull off convincingly. You'd be better off with something more directly connected to Rutledge, either written by him, or by someone condemning him, and in straightforward language.

item.content:encoded:
SCP-518-A is to be monitored by a field research team consisting of at least three (3) staff and one (1) project lead
approximately 2-3 m per SCP-518-B event
a complex consisting of eleven wooden structures

Why you no number consistency dude?

SCP-518 is a localized anomalous phenomenon, catalyzed by the dissemination and exposure of SCP-518-B.

It could possibly be better as SCP-518 is a collective term for the small town and SCP-518-B, because while you go into the effect of SCP-518, you only mention it in relation to SCP-518-B. Calling it its own thing when you haven't written it like its own thing just comes off badly to me.

Overall, it's not badly written but I don't get it. Possibly because chronically sleep deprived lately. But still.
